articles.title: Money is going into data centres and AI in US... now India will be on everyone’s list: Prem Watsa
articles.description: Canadian billionaire Prem Watsa's bet on IDBI Bank is backed by faith in the Indian economy, he told Mohit Bhalla and Sruthijith KK in a phone interview. The government Wednesday approved the divestment of a majority stake in IDBI Bank to Watsa's Fairfax Financial Holdings. Watsa, 76, who was born near Hyderabad and studied at IIT-Madras, migrated to Canada in the 1970s. Started by him as an insurance company, Fairfax Financial now has assets of over $100 billion. Edited excerpts from the interview are in the copy.

articles.title: ON CAM: AOC & El-Sayed Slam Trump’s $5000 Checks; Drop A-Bomb At Michigan Speech
articles.description: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and Abdul El-Sayed delivered a blistering anti-Trump message in Michigan, tying the administration’s economic agenda to rising household costs, federal cuts and the war in Iran. El-Sayed argued that Americans are struggling to afford gas, groceries, mortgages and healthcare while Washington pours money into military spending and overseas wars. He also blamed Trump’s tariff fight with Canada for adding thousands of dollars in costs for American families.AOC joined the attack by accusing the Trump administration of gutting federal agencies, weakening public services and making education and healthcare harder to afford for working families.
